_about: One entry per plant in the yard. 'speciesId' links to species.json for care info. 'position' is in feet (see layout.json). idConfidence is 0-100, and anything under 50 shows an 'unconfirmed' badge. Set confirmedByOwner to true once you've confirmed a plant. Add "finished": "YYYY-MM-DD" when a plant is done (like a crop at the end of its season): it leaves the 3D yard and This week from that date.

plants.label: Blueberry 2
plants.name: Blueberry #2
issues: Yellow leaves with green veins (interveinal chlorosis). Zone B is acidic enough for blueberries but tested LOW in magnesium, and magnesium deficiency causes exactly this pattern, starting on older leaves. If this plant sits in Zone A instead, soil pH may be too high. A soil test right at this plant will tell. Don't add anything until then.
